name: BlockVectra Robinhood Chain RPC
notes: The public TypeScript example selects robinhood_mainnet from the BlockVectra chain directory, requires chain ID 4663, and reads the latest block number. Its read:public command uses no wallet, account sign-up or API key. The example stops if the directory does not advertise the public endpoint or required methods. This source documents an RPC access path, not current endpoint availability.
